name: Can Violence Cure my Little Sister’s Nightmares 2: If a Butterfly Flapped Its Wings, Would We Still Have Nightmares?
source:
When a timid 7-year-old psychic girl discovers a runaway heiress to a haunted mansion hiding in her own dreams, the two must put their heads together to stop the mysterious evil force causing the nightmares. Vivi, the psychic dreamer, is all too eager to help, but the heiress, Natalie, smells like a mysterious evil force.

Jump through the game worlds from Rosin's past and follow the two as they try to escape this nightmare dreamscape!

[From [url=https://rosin.itch.io/nightmares2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一名胆怯的7岁通灵女孩在自己的梦中发现一名离家出走的鬼屋女继承人时，两人必须齐心协力，阻止造成噩梦的神秘邪恶力量。通灵梦想家薇薇非常渴望提供帮助，但女继承人娜塔莉却闻起来像一股神秘的邪恶力量。

穿越罗辛过去的游戏世界，跟随两人试图逃离这个噩梦般的梦境！

[来自[url=https://rosin.itch.io/nightmares2]Itch.io[/url]]
